title: Leaders Eat Last
author: Simon Sinek

lockedEdition.name: Leaders Eat Last: Why Some Teams Pull Together and Others Don't
lockedEdition.format: revised and expanded English trade family centered on the 2017 U.S. paperback

rationale: Penguin Random House and Google Books both identify the 2017 U.S. paperback with ISBN 9781591848011 and describe it as the paperback release with an expanded chapter and appendix on leading millennials.

The same official and authorized-preview metadata also ties the 2017 paperback to the earlier 2014 hardcover and ebook family, which makes the revised trade family materially continuous rather than a structurally different English book.
The frozen catalog TOC shows the same 8-part structure and 27 numbered chapters needed for the learning pipeline, including chapter 24 as The Abstract Generation.

No translation was requested, and the discovered English-edition variation changes the revised-family packaging and expansion notes without altering the core 27-chapter map enough to require user intervention.
